title: cirsium lanceolatum subsp. crinitum
intro: Cirsium lanceolatum subsp. crinitum, commonly known as Woolly Thistle, is a plant species in the sunflower family that is native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Cirsium lanceolatum subsp. crinitum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
